hypothesis: A rank-40 binary-right correction with activation-calibrated exported INT4 left factors can materially improve the complete layer-0 gate-up-down MLP over an honest row-normalized fixed-support ternary control while retaining a projected complete component rate below 1.55 bits per weight.

parents.activation_cache_contract: Up to 256 calibration and 96 disjoint validation rows from the exact BF16 layer-0 prefix, with exact observed row counts authenticated by the cache receipt; no evaluation item enters either split

candidate.representation: Each matrix is exact-64-of-128 ternary with actual row-normalized 4-bit group-scale indices plus a signed per-row INT4 by binary-right rank-40 residual. Gate and up share one binary-right factor; down has one independent binary-right factor.
candidate.activation_training: Freeze binary-right signs and FP16 scales from weight-space initialization, solve ridge-optimal left factors on calibration outputs, then export signed INT4 coefficients with one FP16 scale per output row.
candidate.down_target: Fit the final residual against exact-parent MLP outputs while feeding the candidate SwiGLU intermediate, so the down correction must absorb both down-weight and upstream gate-up error.
candidate.storage_contract: All fixed-support ternary indices, row anchors, four-bit scale indices, FP16 ratio codebooks, INT4 left codes, FP16 left scales, binary right signs, FP16 right scales, and per-component headers are counted.

controls.direct: the same three complete matrices using exact-64-of-128 ternary codes and the same actually decoded row-normalized 4-bit scales, without a residual factor
controls.weight_space: the frozen weight-space binary factors before activation recalibration
controls.separation: Calibration outputs may fit coefficients; only disjoint validation outputs enter promotion.

decision_policy: A parent weight-gate rejection creates a terminal skip and ends this exact rank-40 binary-right family.
A full-MLP activation rejection is terminal for this exact family and does not authorize a seed, rank, ridge, or threshold sweep.
A pass authorizes factor codec materialization and the frozen CUTE, MATH-500, code, MMLU, WikiText, and paired CPU runtime gates only.
Neither a weight-space pass nor an activation-space pass is a model-quality, whole-model, novelty, or breakthrough result.
claim_boundary: Complete full-shape layer-0 MLP activation screen only; not a whole-model artifact, capability result, CPU throughput result, novelty result, or breakthrough.
